text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ah... Where do I even begin?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I was so determined to make you smile
this time
around, but I keep getting
these sorts of results...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If this keeps up, I'll just be dragging you
down...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If this keeps up, I'll just be dragging you
down...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You're right. If I give up now, then all of
your
hard work will go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's one thing I will never do. Mark my
words.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer... How are you always so kind?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I bet it's the strength of your spirit that
allows you
to be so nice.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... How is it that someone so cute
can guide
me with such confidence?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I promise to repay you for your goodwill.
I'll get
first place... for you.
